user.title: Select Gas Company
user.description: Select your gas company from the list below.

auth.title: Enter Authentication Info
auth.description: Enter the access_token, refresh_token, and sign captured from the WeChat mini program. Selected company: {org_name}

select_subs.title: Select Gas Accounts
select_subs.description: Select the gas accounts (meters) to add. Each account will be a separate device.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your tokens have expired. Please re-enter your access_token, refresh_token, and sign. Company: {org_name}

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Please check your access_token, refresh_token, and sign.
error.no_subs_selected: Please select at least one gas account.
error.connect_error: Connection failed. Please check your network.

abort.orglist_load_failed: Failed to load orglist.json. Please check the file exists.

init.title: Reconfigure
init.description: Update your tokens and sign if they have expired. You can also adjust the data refresh interval.
